create_IMDBReviewsConfig: create an IMDBReviewsConfig builder config with plain text encoding for the IMDB dataset
build_Builder_dataset: build a GeneratorBasedBuilder for the IMDB movie reviews dataset with train, test, and unsupervised splits
run_split_generators: run split generators to download and archive the IMDB dataset from Stanford with train, test, and unsupervised splits
run_generate_examples: run generate examples to parse labeled and unlabeled IMDB review text files from the archive into text and label pairs
review_info_features: review the dataset info features including text with configurable encoder and binary sentiment label
